title: You’re Being Ignored by Recruiters (Resume Summary Fix)
description:
Recruiters aren’t ignoring you because you’re unqualified — they’re ignoring you because your resume summary isn’t positioned as a solution.

In this short, I explain the key shift that separates resumes that get skipped from resumes that get interviews.

 Watch Your Resume Summary Has 6 Seconds (Get Seen Series • Part 2) for the full step-by-step breakdown: https://youtu.be/9JXO-jkdbTQ

transcript: Recruiters decide on your resume in just six seconds. And here is the game changer most people miss. Your professional summary shouldn't explain your whole career. It should position you as a solution to the problem this role exists to solve. Every role is created because something isn't working. Growth, change, scale, leadership gaps. When your summary shows you've already solved that problem, recruiters lean in and invite you in for the interview. Here's how you do that fast. Paste the job description into AI and ask, "What problem was this role designed to solve?" Then write your summary around that, not your entire work experience. This one key shift separates résumés that get skipped from the résumés that gets interviewed. I break this down step by step in my get seen series where I link a free cheat sheet for every series. I've linked it in the comments. Follow me at Krishna Careers.
